issues.display_title: Issue #62: feat(chat): add @tour mention autocomplete and sync with chat context
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Add support for mentioning tours via @ in the chat input within the RAG chat widget (frontend-rag-system). Users can search for their tours with real-time autocompletion, select a tour, and have the selected tour context sent with their chat requests to enable cross-page actions and navigation.

Key Requirements

  • Hook useTourMention:
    • Detect @ trigger and extract query after @ up to the cursor.
    • Debounce search calls (350ms) to GoThru API: https://apil.gothru.co/v1/tours/list?search={keyword}&limit=6 using the authenticated user's chat_token.
    • Handle keyboard navigation (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Tab, Escape).
  • Component TourMentionDropdown:
    • Popover/floating list positioned above ChatInput.
    • Item display:
      • Title: business_name
      • Subtitle: CID: {cid} with smaller font (text-xs) and secondary color (text-zinc-500 dark:text-zinc-400).
    • Loading skeleton/spinner and clean empty state.
  • Input & Context Synchronization:
    • Insert selected tour as chip badge above input and in chat bubbles.
    • In ChatInput, synchronize mentioned tours with textarea message and clean up @query trigger.
    • Forward synchronized mentioned_tours in context.mentioned_tours of POST /copilot/chat: 
      {
  "tour_id": "12345",
  "business_name": "Hotel Mulia",
  "cid": "67890"
}
  • Build & Verification:
    • Build widget without errors (npm run build).

Result

1. Tag Feature (@tour Mention & Tour Tags)

  • @ Mention Detection & Decrypted Search: Supports @ trigger detection with 350ms debounce against GoThru API (/v1/tours/list) using user auth tokens, securely decrypting encrypted AES-CBC response payloads.
  • Dropdown & Keyboard Navigation: Displays tour suggestion list showing tour titles and CID subtitles with full keyboard accessibility (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Enter, Tab, Escape).
  • Chip Badge UI: Selected tours are rendered as interactive chip badges above the textarea and within user message bubbles, automatically stripping the trigger @query from the textarea on selection.
  • Context Synchronization: Injects verified selected tours (tour_id, business_name, cid) into context.mentioned_tours in chat requests.

2. Client Action Feature

  • Auto-Trigger Client Actions: Listens for copilot client_action responses and dispatches native gothru:action custom events to the host window when auto_trigger: true.
  • Tour Tools Modals & Navigation Support:
    • Dispatches open_modal actions for archive_tour, transfer_tour, download_tour, add_tour_tags, and delete_tour for both single and multiple target tours.
    • Dispatches navigate actions directly to tour workspaces (/upload, /edit, /publish, /hosted, /my-tours/{id}).
  • Countly Telemetry: Automatically tracks copilot action interactions with rag_* event namespace (rag_client_action_offered, rag_client_action_executed).
